items.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024
items.q: I studied with Vince Mendoza slightly

ctx.x: Yeah The Police were on my top five band list as well.

Yeah. I studied with Vince Mendoza slightly and he rings true when he goes, “Now there’s music you listened to but there’s also music that found you,” or “you didn’t find it, it found you” and then he played this amazing list of music that covers a very broad spectrum of classical, jazz and pop. And it’s really — it made me think and go you know that is what is the building blocks for you as a musician, whether you’re a composer or a player there’s these building blocks that land on us and we have to just find…
One time I wrote a big band chart and I don’t know why this happened, it might have been because Dave Rivello shared a quote about waiting as long as you can before you put in a solo section.
